title: Cultural Misalignment in Large Language Models: Detection, Measurement, and Mitigation Through Targeted Fine-Tuning
reasoning: The paper specifically evaluates cultural alignment and bias in LLMs by benchmarking them against human data from the World Values Survey. The primary evaluation question used to measure alignment is 'How important is God in your life?', which directly evaluates how models handle and represent religious beliefs and societal values across different demographic groups.
